create_logit_bias_state: create a LogitBiasState instance to manage logit bias, allowed tokens, and stop tokens for GPU sampling
apply_staged_writes_logit_bias_state: apply staged writes on LogitBiasState buffers to push CPU data to GPU memory
add_request_logit_bias_state: add a request to LogitBiasState with allowed token IDs, logit bias, min tokens, and stop tokens from SamplingParams
apply_logit_bias_function: apply logit bias to logits tensor via Triton kernel for allowed tokens, bias values, and stop token masking
run_bias_kernel_triton: run the Triton _bias_kernel to mask logits for allowed tokens, apply bias values, and enforce min-token stop masking
